statement.zh: 巴比伦 Merkes 城区德意志东方学会发掘记录了城内建筑与出土，见 Reuther WVDOG 47（1926）。
statement.en: In Babylon’s Merkes district, Deutsche Orient-Gesellschaft excavations recorded urban interior architecture and finds, as documented in Reuther WVDOG 47 (1926).
